title: TasteExposure
description: One recommendation surface render: what was shown, in what order, and the full set of feasible alternatives the ranker chose from. This log is what separates availability from preference (overhaul SPEC section 3.3): cooking what was shown is weak evidence, and the exposure share shown/feasible weights every learned update. Stored in the taste_exposures table; behavioural events reference it by exposureId in their payload.

sessionId.description: Links the render to the session that produced it; null when the surface renders outside a session.

slate.description: What was actually rendered, in display order.

feasible.description: Every recipe that passed the hard filters and feasibility rules for this render — the choice set the slate was drawn from. The slate is always a subset.

householdSize.description: Eaters in the household for this render. No upper bound: households of any size log exposures (SPEC section 5).

mealContext.description: Free-text meal context tag ('weeknight', 'guests', ...), or null.
